# Tabs

Switching between views of the same thing. A choice that changes a value is `Segmented` or a `RadioGroup`.

## Anatomy

A scrollable strip of tabs over a hairline rule, with the selected tab underlined in ink, then the panel.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tabs` *(required)* | `Tab<T>[]` | — | — |
| `value` *(required)* | `T` | — | — |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `onchange` | `(value: T) => void` | — | — |
| `children` *(required)* | `Snippet<[T]>` | — | Rendered inside the panel for the selected tab. |

## Variants

None.

## States

Unselected, selected, disabled, focus-visible.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Enters the strip as one stop, then moves to the panel. |
| `←`, `→` | Move between tabs and select as they go. |
| `Home`, `End` | Jump to the first and last tab. |

## ARIA

`role="tablist"` with `role="tab"` children and a roving tabindex, each tab pointing at its panel through `aria-controls`, and the panel back at its tab through `aria-labelledby` — the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with automatic activation.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Reference correspondence

None as a component. The reference hand-rolls four separate tab-like treatments — in its events screen, its settings screen, its connectors screen and its presentations screen — each with different markup and none with a role. This replaces all four.
